lists.content:
• Define and drive the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for Engagement Journeys across Spotify's consumer experience.
  • Build intelligent engagement systems that help listeners naturally discover new formats, features, and devices based on meaningful behavioral signals.
  • Partner with Machine Learning and Data Science teams to develop models that identify user readiness, engagement opportunities, and long-term growth potential.
  • Translate advances in AI, machine learning, and agent technologies into intuitive product experiences that millions of listeners can easily understand and enjoy.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Design, Research, and Data Science to rapidly prototype, experiment, learn, and deliver high-impact product improvements.
  • Influence the evolution of multiple Spotify surfaces and experiences so engagement journeys feel connected rather than fragmented.
  • Define how Spotify measures meaningful engagement, establishing frameworks that help teams prioritize sustainable listener value over short-term gains.
  • Make thoughtful product decisions using behavioral insights, experimentation, customer research, and data, even when operating with ambiguity.
  • Build alignment across senior leaders and cross-functional teams to deliver initiatives that span multiple organizations.
  • Balance innovation with user trust, quality, privacy, and long-term platform integrity.
